text:
maria: quick ping — PR #8572 is blocked by windows-e2e-smoke failing intermittently. Can someone take a quick look? cc @sam @jen

ci-bot: buildkite.com/redwood/builds/8572 — windows-e2e-smoke failed
Step: test_kv_eviction_timeout.py::test_basic_eviction
Excerpt: AssertionError: eviction took 203ms (expected <= 50ms)
Logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/8572/logs/123

sam: on it. can you paste the failing job link + any bisect info?

maria: job link above. did a narrow bisect locally — points to commit abc1234 (async sleep change in kv/evict.py). bisect output: `git bisect start; git bisect bad HEAD; git bisect good v1.12.3; # result: abc1234`

jen: i can queue a rerun and try to repro on a Win VM. queuing rerun now.

ci-bot: Rebuild queued by jen — buildkite.com/redwood/builds/8572#rerun-1

ci-bot: Rerun complete — linux jobs passed, windows-e2e-smoke still failed (same test). More logs: "Timeout waiting for eviction signal"

oliver: fyi this smells like the driver/timing flake we saw earlier (see issue #402). the async sleep tweak can shift timing on windows.

dave: i'd prefer we don't unblock the release by reverting yet unless we're confident. can we safely xfail this specific test on windows and follow up?

maria: change is fairly small and non-customer-facing. i'll open an issue and add a conditional xfail for Windows in the test harness if folks agree. created issue https://go/repro/issue/6321 with logs & bisect notes.

sam: i'm ok with temporary xfail + follow-up. :thumbsup:

jen: pushed test skip to the branch (skips on windows only). asked CI to rerun. also added repro steps to the issue.

ci-bot: Rerun queued by jen — buildkite.com/redwood/builds/8572#rerun-2

ci-bot: Rerun results: all required jobs passed. windows-e2e-smoke now marked xfailed for this run.

ci-bot: Merge blocked — PR needs at least one approval and a green status.

sam: approving now. :white_check_mark:

maria: merging once approvals are in, thanks everyone for quick eyes. i'll own follow-up on issue #6321 and schedule a flake debugging session next week.

jen: thanks all — will monitor post-merge smoke.
